name: daniel_okoye
title: Acute Care Physical Therapist III
job_desc:
Physical Therapist III - Acute Care - Memorial Lakes Hospital (Houston, TX)
Senior acute care PT role covering ICU, neuro and cardiac units. Lead early mobility in the ICU, make discharge recommendations, mentor staff therapists and students, and take part in quality and falls prevention work.
Requirements: Texas PT license; 5+ years acute care; BLS; ACLS preferred; NCS or CCS preferred; Epic documentation; strong interdisciplinary communication.

interview.question: How do you decide whether a patient is safe to go home?
interview.answer: I look at how they move and if they have help at home. I talk to the team and recommend what they need.

facts: The ICU early mobility program Daniel helped run cut average ICU length of stay by about 1 day.
He sees 10 to 12 acute care patients a day.
He trained and mentored 8 new therapists on the neuro unit.
The falls committee he sits on reduced inpatient falls on his units by about 20% in a year.
He leads monthly in-services for nursing staff on safe patient mobility.
